title: Randy Rainbow Dissects the Midterm Blue Wave, Decimates Trump’s Second Term On ‘He’s a Flop!’: ‘He’s the Schmo Most Hated’
summary: The singer's latest parody tune hits a ragtime mood as Rainbow ticks off all of The Donald's many low points over the past two years.
contentText:
Randy Rainbow is never at a loss for words when it comes to launching tuneful, comedic broadsides against the man he affectionately refers to as “Donald Jessica Trump.” In his latest parody video, “He’s a Flop!,” Rainbow leans into a classic comedic trope to dance on Trump’s flaming pile of disasters by making it look like he’s on the other side of a serious, 60 Minutes -style interview on the news program he’s renamed 60 Magats .

Randy Rainbow Drags ‘Dumbf–k Tyrant’ Donald Trump in Jazzy Song Parody Amid Iran War Discontent

The six-minute video uses footage from a Trump interview about how he asked his MAGA faithful to pretend he was on the ballot before Democrats made historic gains in Congress and flipped both the House and Senate in a stinging rebuke of Trump’s agenda. “Well, you did manage to flip the whole damn country and now everyone’s distancing themselves from you,” Rainbow says. “Republicans, your stylist … obviously.”

Eventually, Rainbow gets to the heat of the meat, telling Trump that if you set aside the rising inflation, the tariffs, the sky-high grocery prices, the healthcare cuts, the ICE raids, the Epstein files disaster, “the wars, the corruption, the incompetence your overall proclivity for f–king everything up,” he thinks No. 47 is No. 1.

“At presidenting he’s unrelenting that he does it the very best/ To find one better you’d be hard-pressed,” Rainbow croons over subtle piano as he rolls into the list of Trump’s term two tumult. “He’s a flop/ He’s the lowest rated/ He’s a flop/ He’s the schmo most hated,” he sings in the tune inspired by Cole Porter’s 1934 classic “You’re the Top” from Anything Goes .

The list of indignities goes on and on: “He’s a cargo hold in the Strait of Old Hormuz/ He’s a Kid Rock pee test/ Melania’s be best/ He’s Marco’s shoes/ He’s the kitsch/ In his ballroom floor plan/ He’s a b–ch/ He’s a Hegseth war plan/ He’s a dull Aldean or hokey Greenwood bop/ That’s why, baby, he keeps flailing/ He’s a flop,” Rainbow sings in the ragtimey tune.

In his inimitably spicy way, Rainbow hits Trump where it hurts the most, dissing his “cheap” spray tan, calling him a “childless lady with cats” as far as his VP, JD Vance, is concerned and comparing him to a rap tune from his new pal, Nicki Minaj and Hunter Biden’s notorious laptop. Rainbow goes low with one particular reference, alluding to the deeply goofy calf-baring capri pants Trump family friend Andrew Tate — who is facing 42 criminal charges in the U.K. including rape, assault, sex trafficking and civil assault, among others — wore during his arrest earlier this year.

Along the way, Rainbow takes playful swipes at Trump’s blink-and-you-missed-it press secretary Katie Zacharia, calls him worse than the raging measles outbreak in the U.S., describes him as the “lube at a Diddy freak-off” and offers up a succinct diss that pretty much sums up Trump 2.0 for many disaffected voters: “he’s the peeling paint in an algae-tainted pool.”
